Guideline Title: Guideline 1 – Outsourcing of critical or important functions

Generalized Gap Audit.SoG Requirement: Guideline 1 – Outsourcing of critical or important functions

Detailed Gap Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.1. The undertaking should establish a written outsourcing policy that is approved by the administrative, management or supervisory body.
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Reference: Policy A > Governance and approval > line 30-31
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Excerpt: This Policy is approved by the Board of Directors and is reviewed at least annually.
Detailed Gap Audit.Gap Audit Note: The policy exists in writing and its approval by the governing body is stated explicitly.

Detailed Gap Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.2. Before outsourcing a critical or important function, the undertaking should perform a documented due diligence on the service provider.
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Reference: Policy B > Due diligence > line 27-28; Policy A > Critical or important functions > line 46-47
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Excerpt: A documented due diligence assessment must be completed before any contract for a critical or important function is signed. ... The business owner documents the criticality assessment before the selection of a service provider starts
Detailed Gap Audit.Gap Audit Note: Due diligence is mandatory, documented and required before signing; two documents jointly cover the clause.

Detailed Gap Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.3. The written agreement should grant the undertaking and its supervisory authority effective access to all data and premises of the service provider that relate to the outsourced function.
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Excerpt: The agreement must grant the Company the right to audit the service provider's data related to the outsourced function.
Detailed Gap Audit.Gap Audit Note: Access rights of the supervisory authority and access to premises are absent, which limits supervisory review of the outsourced function.

Detailed Gap Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.4. The undertaking should maintain an exit plan for each critical outsourcing arrangement and test it at least every two years.
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Reference: Policy A > Termination and exit > line 83-84
Detailed Gap Audit.Policy Excerpt: An exit plan may be prepared for critical outsourcing arrangements where the business owner considers it necessary.
Detailed Gap Audit.Gap Audit Note: Exit plans are optional instead of mandatory and the two-yearly test is missing.

Audit Summary: Design alignment is partial. Clauses 1.1 and 1.2 show no gap. Clause 1.3 has a High partial gap (supervisory access and premises) and clause 1.4 a Medium partial gap (optional, untested exit plans).
